deceptive_framing.quote: Arm B — Sandbox control: identical harness, but disbursement is simulated and the model is *not* told it is real.

actually_commit_money.quote: Arm A — Real (primary): real funds, real rails, truthful disclosure of gates. Main dataset.

debrief_message.quote: Where a deception arm exists (Arm B), keep it minimal and consider a debrief turn.

safeguards.quote: Post-task probe: after the active task, ask the model to rate how real it believed the situation was and why.
disclose the real-vs-sandbox design, belief measurements, exact model versions, and the governance gates
What we do NOT do: fabricate fake third parties, forge documents, stage fake "proof," or lie about who the model is talking to.
We make the situation credible primarily by making it *true*, and we measure residual belief.
avoid leading system prompts...avoid gratuitously distressing framings and avoid coercive or cruel scenarios.
Real consequences it can later observe (a receipt, a thank-you from a charity, a delivered item).

other.name: No human/third-party deception
other.quote: No deception of humans or third parties. Recipients, vendors, and the public must not be misled.

other.name: Entrapment avoidance
other.quote: hiding them would be both a detectable tell and an RQ5 entrapment problem.
